name: Re Protocol reUSD
oneLiner: Re Protocol's senior NAV-based reinsurance tranche, issued by Resilience (BVI) Ltd with offchain exposure through principal-at-risk notes.
collateral: Onchain stablecoins and offchain reinsurance capital support the senior tranche. The instant redemption buffer is sized from 50% of the deposit high-water mark but can draw down; token holders have no direct legal claim on Section 114 trust assets and obtain offchain exposure through principal-at-risk notes.
pegMechanism: NAV-based token price recalculated daily at UTC 00:00 from a blend of the offchain SOFR-based return and the onchain trailing sUSDe basis rate, plus 250 bps; instant redemptions are liquidity-limited and fall back to a quarterly queue

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Re documentation describes reUSD as the senior tranche of a reinsurance-capital structure with offchain exposure through principal-at-risk notes supporting Regulation 114 trust collateral. That architecture is a real-world credit/fund exposure rather than a synthetic delta-neutral mechanism.
